envelope.description: Add the shared failure type and the definition checks

body.title: Add the shared failure type and the definition checks
body.summary: Create the core, core.common and core.utils packages with docstring-only __init__ files, the failures module and the validation module, with their tests.
acceptanceChecks: The seven failure kind values equal the contract strings and str of a failure is its message
A blank message or unknown kind raises ValueError or TypeError
Each check returns the value unchanged or raises an invalid_input Failure naming the field
A wrong type, a boolean or negative position, and a time without an offset are rejected; a time ending in Z is accepted
failures imports nothing from the project and validation imports only failures

tests.name: tests/test_failures.py: failure kind values equal the contract and a failure reads as its message
tests/test_failures.py: a blank message or unknown kind is a programming error
tests/test_validation.py: each check returns an accepted value unchanged
tests/test_validation.py: each check rejects an invalid value with an invalid_input failure naming the field
